title: Can I BEAT Soko Chess?
summary: Soko Chess (Steam): a minimalist Sokoban-style chess puzzle game. You control white piece(s) (rook first, later bishop etc.) and must PUSH black pawns onto marked destination squares (red pawn icons) instead of capturing. Black pawns still capture diagonally, so you must avoid stepping into their attack. Undo (Y/Z) and restart (R/B) available. Tony clears levels 1-10 ('Humble Beginning' first) and peeks at 11.
rules: Puzzle levels, no opponent AI: move your white piece(s) with normal chess movement.
Moving into a black pawn pushes it one square in the movement direction; goal: push every black pawn onto a destination marker.
Black pawns capture diagonally (one square) after your move if you land in their attack; being captured fails the level.
Later levels add bishops and sacrificial tactics (pawn takes back).
win_condition: Push all black pawns onto their destination squares (complete the level).

rules_corrected: Select a white piece (tap), it shows yellow move dots; deselect with right click / tap again.
White pieces move like chess (rook orth slide, bishop diag slide, white pawn 1 up; white pawn 'captures' diagonally up). Missing tiles (holes) block sliding.

Moving onto a black piece PUSHES it one square further in the movement direction (diagonal pushes for pawn/bishop). Mover ends on the pushed piece's old square. Push only if the square behind is a tile and empty: cannot push off the board, cannot push into another piece.
A pushable black piece in the selected piece's line is drawn YELLOW (frame L4: yellow pawn = push target, NOT 'pawn on target' as the old impl assumed).
Targets: small red piece icon in a tile's top-left corner shows which TYPE belongs there (pawn icon or rook icon); icon turns GREEN when the matching black piece stands on it.

Black pieces only move to capture: black pawns capture diagonally DOWN the screen (toward the player, like normal chess); black rooks capture along clear lines. The capturer moves onto the captured square (used to 'sack' pieces to drop a black piece onto its target).
Capturing priority: each black piece may show a number; 1 captures before 2 etc. (L9 shows 1-4; L8 'rook with its last capturing priority'). One capture per turn is INFERRED.
Black pieces on their target can still capture.
Sacrifices are allowed; level is won when every target holds a black piece of the icon's type. Losing all white pieces = stuck (undo/restart).
Unlimited undo (Y/Z or HUD undo icon), restart (R/B or HUD restart icon). Levels later add white pawns (L5), enemy rooks + rook targets (L7-9), bishop (L10).
